channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-132224 — Optimizely Web Experimentation
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

item.title: CVE-2026-131914 — Idunno AntiCsrf
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: CVE-2026-132165 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 52. Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2026-41940 — WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.

item.title: CVE-2024-57726 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

item.title: CVE-2025-32432 — Craft CMS Craft CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-22681 — Rockwell Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

item.title: CVE-2025-49113 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 75. RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

item.title: CVE-2008-0015 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

item.title: CVE-2026-24423 — SmarterTools SmarterMail
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SmarterTools SmarterMail contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in the ConnectToHub API method. This could allow the attacker to point the SmarterMail instance to a malicious HTTP server which serves the malicious OS command and could lead to command execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-52691 — SmarterTools SmarterMail
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SmarterTools SmarterMail contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to any location on the mail server, potentially enabling remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-3962 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an uninitialized memory corruption vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2020-25078 — D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow for remote administrator password disclosure. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2019-5418 — Rails Ruby on Rails
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Rails Ruby on Rails contains a path traversal vulnerability in Action View. Specially crafted accept headers in combination with calls to `render file:` can cause arbitrary files on the target server to be rendered, disclosing the file contents.

item.title: CVE-2025-31324 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated agent to upload potentially malicious executable binaries.

item.title: CVE-2024-55956 — Cleo Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to import and execute arbitrary bash or PowerShell commands on the host system by leveraging the default settings of the Autorun directory.

item.title: CVE-2024-9474 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation through the web-based management interface for several PAN products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

item.title: CVE-2024-1212 — Progress Kemp LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-25280 — D-Link DIR-820 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp.

item.title: CVE-2024-4879 — ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
item.description: Threat Signal 75. ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform releases contain a jelly template injection vulnerability in UI macros. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2022-24816 — OSGeo JAI-EXT
item.description: Threat Signal 75. OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT contains a code injection vulnerability that, when programs use jt-jiffle and allow Jiffle script to be provided via network request, could allow remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-17519 — Apache Flink
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Apache Flink contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to read any file on the local filesystem of the JobManager through its REST interface.

item.title: CVE-2024-4040 — CrushFTP CrushFTP
item.description: Threat Signal 75. CrushFTP contains an unspecified sandbox escape vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to escape the CrushFTP virtual file system (VFS).

item.title: CVE-2023-41265 — Qlik Sense
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

item.title: CVE-2017-6884 — Zyxel EMG2926 Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

item.title: CVE-2019-20500 — D-Link DWL-2600AP Access Point
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DWL-2600AP access point contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability via the Save Configuration functionality in the Web interface, using shell metacharacters in the admin.cgi?action=config_save configBackup or downloadServerip parameter.

item.title: CVE-2022-36537 — ZK Framework AuUploader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

item.title: CVE-2021-39226 — Grafana Labs Grafana
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

item.title: CVE-2018-17463 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2012-1889 — Microsoft XML Core Services
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft XML Core Services contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-3953 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an array boundary issue in Universal 3D (U3D) support that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-0431 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) component in Oracle allows remote attackers to bypass the Java security sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2017-8291 — Artifex Ghostscript
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Artifex Ghostscript allows -dSAFER bypass and remote command execution via .rsdparams type confusion with a "/OutputFile.

item.title: CVE-2017-8543 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2014-0322 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2014-0160 — OpenSSL OpenSSL
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The TLS and DTLS implementations in OpenSSL do not properly handle Heartbeat Extension packets, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2019-1003029 — Jenkins Script Security Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Jenkins Script Security Plugin contains a protection mechanism failure, allowing an attacker to bypass the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2018-7841 — Schneider Electric U.motion Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

item.title: CVE-2016-7200 — Microsoft Edge
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2015-2426 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Windows when the Windows Adobe Type Manager Library improperly handles specially crafted OpenType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2017-6316 — Citrix NetScaler SD-WAN Enterprise, CloudBridge Virtual WAN, and XenMobile Server
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A vulnerability has been identified in the management interface of Citrix NetScaler SD-WAN Enterprise and Standard Edition and Citrix CloudBridge Virtual WAN Edition that could result in an unauthenticated, remote attacker being able to execute arbitrary code as a root user. This vulnerability also affects XenMobile Server.

item.title: CVE-2014-6324 — Microsoft Kerberos Key Distribution Center (KDC)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The Kerberos Key Distribution Center (KDC) in Microsoft allows remote authenticated domain users to obtain domain administrator privileges.

item.title: CVE-2005-2773 — Hewlett Packard (HP) OpenView Network Node Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 75. HP OpenView Network Node Manager could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the system.

item.title: CVE-2020-5135 — SonicWall SonicOS
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A buffer overflow vulnerability in SonicOS allows a remote attacker to cause Denial of Service (DoS) and potentially execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the firewall.

item.title: CVE-2015-3043 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A memory corruption vulnerability exists in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-0787 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows BITS is vulnerable to to a privilege elevation vulnerability if it improperly handles symbolic links. An actor can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code with system-level privileges.

item.title: CVE-2012-0391 — Apache Struts 2
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The ExceptionDelegator component in Apache Struts 2 before 2.2.3.1 contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-33766 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to steal email traffic from target.

item.title: CVE-2020-14864 — Oracle Intelligence Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Path traversal vulnerability, where an attacker can target the preview FilePath parameter of the getPreviewImage function to get access to arbitrary system file.
